# StreamElements sub-actions

## Add user points

Gives a viewer StreamElements loyalty points, or takes some away with a negative number. Good for rewards.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | The viewer's login name. The default %userName% means the person who ran the action. Make sure it is their name on the streaming site. Starts as: `%userName%`. |
| **Points** | How many points to give. Use a minus sign, like -50, to take points away. Starts as: `100`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%sePoints%` | Their points after the change |

<small>Type id: `streamelements.addUserPoints`</small>

## Get latest tips

Looks up your most recent StreamElements tips. Handy to show or read out the latest supporters.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Tips** | How many of the latest tips to fetch. 5 gets the five newest. Starts as: `5`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%seTipCount%` | How many tips were found |
| `%seTip0User%` | Who sent the newest tip (use 1, 2, 3... for older ones) |
| `%seTip0Amount%` | How much it was (use 1, 2, 3... for older ones) |
| `%seTip0Currency%` | Its currency |
| `%seTip0FormattedAmount%` | The amount written nicely |
| `%seTip0Message%` | Their message |
| `%seTip0CreatedAt%` | When it was sent |

<small>Type id: `streamelements.getTips`</small>

## Get points leaderboard

Looks up your top viewers by StreamElements loyalty points. Handy to read out a top list in chat.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Users** | How many people to fetch, starting from the top. 5 gets the top five. Starts as: `5`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%sePointsLeaderCount%` | How many people were found |
| `%sePointsLeader0User%` | The name of number 1 (use 1, 2, 3... for the next ones) |
| `%sePointsLeader0Total%` | Their points (use 1, 2, 3... for the next ones) |

<small>Type id: `streamelements.getPointsLeaderboard`</small>

## Get tip leaderboard

Looks up the people who tipped you the most on StreamElements. Handy for a thank-you list.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Tippers** | How many people to fetch, starting from the top. 5 gets the top five. Starts as: `5`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%seTipLeaderCount%` | How many people were found |
| `%seTipLeader0User%` | The name of number 1 (use 1, 2, 3... for the next ones) |
| `%seTipLeader0Total%` | How much they tipped in total (use 1, 2, 3... for the next ones) |

<small>Type id: `streamelements.getTipLeaderboard`</small>

## Get user points

Looks up how many StreamElements loyalty points a viewer has. Handy for a "you have X points" chat reply.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | The viewer's login name. The default %userName% means the person who ran the action. Make sure it is their name on the streaming site. Starts as: `%userName%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%sePointsUser%` | The viewer's name |
| `%sePoints%` | Their points right now |
| `%sePointsAllTime%` | All the points they ever earned |
| `%sePointsRank%` | Their place on your points list (1 is the top) |

<small>Type id: `streamelements.getUserPoints`</small>
